text_block_list.text:

text_block_list.text:
Mayano, you worked so hard! Mayano's 
Marvelous grew so many times bigger!!

text_block_list.text:
"Running together conveys so much!☆ What 
Mayano is feeling, and what thoughts are 
in her head as she runs!★☆"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Nihihi♪ Maya totally gets how you feel, 
Mave-chin! I could really feel how happy 
you were to run☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
So let's run together again, okay?☆ Maya's 
gonna get way, way stronger, so make sure 
you keep up and don't fall behind! 
Promise♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
That's right, Maya's gonna get even 
stronger! 'Cause I promised to show him—!

I greet Marvelous Sunday in the 
underground tunnel after her race.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I'm back, Trainer!! I just ran the Kikuka 
Sho!!

text_block_list.text:
The people in the crowd! The racing 
Umamusume! Because everyone's feelings are

text_block_list.text:
I wanna run in a big race again☆ I want to 
deliver that marvelous feeling to everyone

Looks like she enjoyed the big stage 
without feeling intimidated! Her 
positivity is so reassuring at times like 
this.
